description: This file defines a custom exception class `SimpleBankingGlobalException` used for global exception handling in the banking application. It includes annotations for Lombok to generate boilerplate code and extends RuntimeException.

classes.name: SimpleBankingGlobalException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class with fields for error code and message, providing constructors for initialization.

methods.name: SimpleBankingGlobalException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, calling the superclass constructor.
